name.text: Changing the Subject 4 - Put the steps in order (ordering)

questiontext.text:
A boda boda rider's speed is given by the formula \(v = u + at\), where \(v\) is the final speed, \(u\) is the starting speed, \(a\) is the acceleration and \(t\) is the time.

Starting from \(v = u + at\), put the steps below in the correct order to make \(t\) the subject of the formula.

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

To make \(t\) the subject, undo the operations around it in reverse order. First subtract \(u\) from both sides, because \(u\) is added. Then divide both sides by \(a\), because \(t\) is multiplied by \(a\).

answer.text: Subtract \(u\) from both sides: \(v - u = at\)
Divide both sides by \(a\): \(\dfrac{v - u}{a} = t\)
Rewrite with \(t\) on the left: \(t = \dfrac{v - u}{a}\)
